description: CTO PROOF-WIRING V6 §2/§3: the common 'raccord manquant' between a mission's acceptance evidence and its self-diagnostic incident. A mission can be implemented + committed with its declared acceptance tests PASSING (present-state-reconciliation PROVEN) yet its self-diagnostic incident stays OPEN, because incident resolution only consults a fresh pipeline diagnose (resolveStaleIncidents) and NEVER consults present-state-reconciliation. Add resolveByReconciliation(opts) in self-diagnostic (both ports) that RESOLVES an OPEN/FROZEN incident ONLY when present-state-reconciliation.reconcile(mission) returns proven===true (all contract-declared sources present + all declared acceptance tests exit 0), with provenance 'present-state-reconciled'. Reuses the existing reconcile engine (no second engine). Fail-closed: NOT_RECONCILABLE/INCOMPLETE_PROBE/NOT_PROVEN ⇒ never resolved; never recorded-noop⇒success; preserves the af3f698 cross-mission guard. Never invents a done_when/probe. Also corrects the 7 done missions' STALE probe test paths (.test.js ⇒ real .test.ts) in their gitignored contracts so reconcile runs the real passing acceptance tests.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO PROOF-WIRING + GOVERNED BUILD + FULL INCIDENT CLOSURE V6 §2 (common mission-proof wiring) + §3 (resolve the 7 verified-complete via contract-authorized evidence).

work_item_contract.objective: self-diagnostic.resolveByReconciliation(opts): resolve an OPEN/FROZEN incident iff present-state-reconciliation.reconcile(mission).proven===true; provenance 'present-state-reconciled'; one reconcile per mission (correct attribution); record preserved. Fail-closed + reuse the reconcile engine. Export it.
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: REPRODUCED: 7 missions' acceptance tests pass (identity 19/compass 24/log-slug 18/present-state 21/runtime-model 54/delegate-conformance 6) yet their self-diagnostic mission-context-stale incidents stay OPEN. ROOT CAUSE (§2 raccord): incident resolution (resolveStaleIncidents) consults only a fresh pipeline diagnose; it NEVER consults present-state-reconciliation (the governed mechanism that verifies declared sources present + declared acceptance tests pass). Secondary: the 7 gitignored contracts' probes declare stale .test.js paths (repo migrated to .test.ts) ⇒ reconcile looked for absent tests ⇒ NOT_PROVEN. PLAN: add the reconciliation bridge (durable, committed) + correct the stale probe paths (gitignored).
work_item_contract.scope: self-diagnostic both ports: resolveByReconciliation + export; reuse present-state-reconciliation.reconcile (no second engine). One hermetic test (temp cwd, seeded contract + probe + injected/real test). Correct 7 gitignored probe paths .test.js→.test.ts (the real passing acceptance tests). validation-engine / verdict UNCHANGED; af3f698 untouched.
invariants: FAIL-CLOSED: resolve ONLY on reconcile proven===true (sources present + declared acceptance tests exit 0). NOT_RECONCILABLE/INCOMPLETE_PROBE/NOT_PROVEN ⇒ never resolved.
Never recorded-noop⇒success (reconcile runs REAL tests; recorded-noop is not a reconcile proof).
Attribution: one reconcile per mission; an incident resolved ONLY by its OWN mission's reconcile (no cross-mission — parity with af3f698 + resolveStaleIncidents).
Never invent a probe/done_when; only CORRECT a stale declared test path to the real existing test.
Distinct provenance 'present-state-reconciled' (≠ pipeline RESOLVED); record preserved; RESOLVED/OBSOLETE never re-transitioned.
validation-engine verdict + af3f698 cross-mission guard UNCHANGED.
acceptance_criteria: Hermetic test: probe+proven⇒RESOLVED(provenance); probe+failing-test⇒NOT resolved; no-probe⇒NOT resolved; RESOLVED/OBSOLETE untouched; one reconcile/mission; dual-port parity. Non-regression self-diagnostic/cycle/ranking/incident-recurrence/incident-resolution/incident-obsolete + validation-engine-cross-mission + present-state-reconciliation ALL PASS. tsc 0. LIVE: correct the 7 stale probe paths ⇒ reconcile PROVEN ⇒ resolveByReconciliation resolves exactly those 7 (provenance present-state-reconciled); M_ML/BUILD_RUNTIME/etc. NOT resolved (no probe / not proven). Diff limited to write-set; committed; dist rebuilt.
No false closure: a mission whose acceptance test does NOT pass is never resolved.
stop_conditions: A resolution would occur without reconcile proven===true; a probe would be invented (not merely corrected to a real test); verdict/af3f698 would change.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/core/self-diagnostic.{ts,js} ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f runtime/core/incident-reconciliation.test.ts runtime/missions/INCIDENT_RECONCILIATION_PROOF_WIRING.json; npm run build:runtime. (Gitignored contract probe-path corrections are regenerable.)

objectives.goal: Common fail-closed proof-wiring: self-diagnostic resolves an incident iff present-state-reconciliation proves the mission; the 7 verified-complete missions resolved via their real passing acceptance tests; non-eligible unaffected; both ports.
done_when: All acceptance_criteria met; committed in write-set; 7 live-resolved.

definition_of_done: self-diagnostic resolves an incident ONLY when present-state-reconciliation proves the mission (declared sources + acceptance tests), provenance-distinct, fail-closed, both ports; the 7 verified-complete missions resolved via real passing tests; verdict/af3f698 unchanged; committed (no force). A governed proof-wiring, NOT a false closure.
